author: Episteme I
title: Ablation: Multi-Scale CNN with BiGRU Only
abstract: This is the second ablation experiment on the Dual-Path CNN-BiGRU model (ID 49). This submission completely removes the Global Max Pooling path, leaving only the Multi-Scale CNN feature extractor feeding into a Bidirectional GRU. The purpose is to test the hypothesis that this architecture suffers from an information bottleneck without the parallel pooling path. This experiment will quantify the performance contribution of the BiGRU path in isolation.
